SIn estrellas, hace un mes cargue nafta y comentaban los expendedores que tenian problemas con los filtros, , vuelvo de Miramar y llegando a Balcarce, se me traba ub inyector, llevo el auto a ROMERA HNOS, VW de Balcarce me cambian el inyector y me comenta el jefe de taller que el motivo de la rotura fue la mala calidad de la nafta, logicamente nunca mas cargo en ACA MIRAMAR, son delincuentes, me coasto $ 33000 el arreglo

No stars. A month ago, I filled up with gas and the attendants were saying they were having problems with the filters. I was coming back from Miramar and getting to Balcarce when one of my injectors got stuck. I took the car to Romera Hnos., the VW dealership in Balcarce, they replaced the injector, and the head mechanic told me the problem was the poor quality of the gasoline. Obviously, I'll never fill up at ACA Miramar again; they're crooks. The repair cost me $33,000.
